title: mcp: no knowledge tool is served, so an app's `aiExposed` knowledge sources are unreachable over MCP, and every skill that binds `search_knowledge` is silently withheld from `prompts/list`
body:
Filing gate ①: a reproducible defect and a contract violation (declared ≠ delivered).
Source: evaluation of the BrightRule app (`objectstack-ai/brightrule`, branch `feature/policy-inquiry`) over the MCP server of ObjectOS EE `ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/objectos-ee:18.6.0` (`objectstack` server 18.6.0), local stack, 2026-11-23. The client was a minimal MCP client driving `deepseek-flash` as the customer's own model (BYO-AI).
Dedupe: `mcp search_knowledge` and `mcp knowledge tool` found nothing on this. #32767 / #32885 (withhold a skill whose bound tools a connection does not serve) are the closed design this issue runs into, not duplicates.

## What happens

The app mounts `KnowledgeServicePlugin` with one object source (`policy_clauses`, `aiExposed` defaults to `true`) and a vector adapter; the index is built (10 rows in pgvector). It also ships a skill, `brightrule_policy_inquiry`, with `instructions` and `tools: ['search_knowledge', 'query_records', 'get_record', 'action_brightrule_escalate_question']`.

Over `/api/v1/mcp` with an admin session:

1. `initialize` → capabilities `prompts`, `tools`; generic server instructions (1,445 chars, governed metrics first).
2. `tools/list` → 17 tools: object CRUD, files, `list_actions` / `run_action` / `resume_run`, `list_datasets` / `query_dataset`, `validate_expression`. No knowledge search tool.
3. `prompts/list` → `[]`. The app skill is withheld because `search_knowledge` is not served (`skill-prompts.ts:222` `if (served && !skillBindingServed(row, served)) continue;`). Every other binding entry is served: `query_records`, `get_record`, and the action through the `run_action` door.
4. Nothing reports either fact. `os validate` passes, the boot is quiet, and the author only learns it by listing prompts on a live connection.

## Why (origin/main e9fa6b5d06)

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts:3138` `wireBridgeTools` registers the object, file, action, federation, dataset (ADR-0149 D2) and package-doc (#35442) families. There is no knowledge family, so a knowledge source can be searched by nothing that MCP serves.

## The contract it breaks

- `@objectstack/skills` 18.6.0, `objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`: "`search_knowledge` tool exposes registered sources to agents"; `aiExposed`: "May `search_knowledge` expose this source to agents (default `true`)".
- `skill-prompts.ts` module doc (#3905): ADR-0063 §2 names skills and MCP as the only third-party extension primitive, and the open distribution is MCP-only (BYO-AI). On that distribution, an app's knowledge base and any skill that relies on it are both unreachable.

## Measured impact (11 policy questions × 2 runs, DeepSeek as the MCP client)

| | client gets only the server instructions | customer pastes the skill's instructions by hand |
|---|---|---|
| Correct answer with a cited clause | 18/18 | 18/18 |
| No-basis questions escalated (`run_action`) | 0/4 | 4/4 |
| No-basis answers padded with non-policy content | 1/4 | 0/4 |
| Median input tokens per question | ~97.5k | ~66.8k |
| Retrieval | keyword `query_records`, reading the whole catalogue | same |

The rules reach the model only when a person copies them into each client, and retrieval is keyword-only. That works on a 10-clause corpus and grows linearly in tokens with the corpus. For the in-product side see objectstack-ai/cloud#4933 (`search_knowledge` never registered) and objectstack-ai/cloud#4935 (`ask` ignores package skills). With both simulated, the same model called the knowledge tool first on 27/27 questions.

## Expected

1. **Serve a knowledge family on MCP.** Register `search_knowledge` when the kernel has a `knowledge` service and the grant admits `data:read`, like `registerDatasetTools` / `registerPackageDocTools`. Pass the caller's execution context: the open knowledge service already re-checks every object-source hit against the caller's row-level security and drops hits when no identity is passed. Only sources with `aiExposed !== false` are searchable.
2. **Make withholding visible.** When a skill with `instructions` is withheld because a bound tool is not served, say so: an `os validate` / lint warning that names the skill and the tool no MCP connection serves, and/or a boot or debug log line. Today the skill disappears without a trace.

Related (filed together): objectstack-ai/objectstack#36647 (artifact boot drops app code plugins, so on EE the knowledge service itself does not mount), objectstack-ai/cloud#4933, objectstack-ai/cloud#4934, objectstack-ai/cloud#4935.
